title: Stir Fried Spaghetti
description: A simple and quick spaghetti stir fry recipe that combines Asian flavors with Italian pasta.

ingredients.name: nutty stir oil
ingredients.notes: Use any neutral oil like vegetable or canola oil

ingredients.name: noodles garnish (optional)
ingredients.notes: Chopped green onions or sesame seeds

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
Heat the nutty stir oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the light soy sauce and korean chili flakes, stir to combine.
Once the spaghetti is cooked, drain it and add it to the skillet or wok.
Stir fry the spaghetti in the sauce for 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the stir fried spaghetti to a serving dish and garnish with noodles garnish (if using).
